description: The Asheville boom has gone bust for too many people in our community. But Raleigh holds us hostage and has been an obstacle to local progress for far too long. As your next State Senator, I will fight to unchain Asheville and Buncombe County from these restraints and work to improve the lives of working class families.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Julie Mayfield for NC Senate
title: Together We Can Tackle Our Affordability Crisis - Julie Mayfield for NC Senate
